items.title: Know your course
items.detail: Why this course, why this university, and what comes after. Say it in two lines.

items.title: Be clear on funding
items.detail: Who pays and how. Keep those documents in hand.

items.title: Be honest
items.detail: Say what's true. If you don't know something, say so. Don't make up a story.

items.title: Documents in order
items.detail: One folder, the right sequence. Give exactly what they ask for.

youtube.title: Visa interview coming up? Have these 4 things ready
youtube.description:
Before your visa interview, have these 4 things ready: why you chose your course and university, a clear funding plan with documents, honest answers, and your documents in one folder in the right order.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. You contact us, we never contact you first.
